name: fk-corporate-income-tax
description: Compute ordinary Falkland Islands corporation tax for accounting periods in 2026. Covers resident companies and non-resident business activity, with separate UK treaty permanent-establishment screening. Explains the progressive rates, worldwide associated-company threshold, short periods, taxable-profit reconciliation, loss claims, accounting-period payment and period-of-account filing deadlines. Use for Falklands corporate tax, pay and file, tax return, branch tax, group relief and late-filing questions. Includes an ordinary computation and a decision on the effect of an overseas associated company. Petroleum ring-fence work, specialist asset categories and group restructurings require the separate statutory analysis indicated in the Guide.
